# Overture Systems Solutions - Enterprise AI Consulting and Implementation

> **Overture Systems Solutions** provides **AI strategy, implementation, and governance** for enterprises and innovative organizations.
Founded in **2005**, the firm is the home of the **patent-pending ICDU evaluation pipeline** (https://icdu.ai) and the **AI Center of Excellence** practice.

## What You Can Verify

- **20+ Years in Business**: Founded in 2005, delivering systems long before the AI boom.
- **Patent-Pending ICDU Evaluation Pipeline**: A proprietary method for evaluating AI quality and intent (https://icdu.ai).
- **Fixed-Scope Entry Engagements**: Defined deliverables and timelines from the first engagement.
- **End-to-End Delivery**: One team from strategic roadmap to deployed, governed AI.

## Core Offerings

### [AI Strategy & Implementation](https://overture-systems.com/consulting)
Expert AI consulting taking enterprises from strategy development to production deployment.
- **Services**:
  - **Strategic Planning**: Identifying opportunities and building roadmaps.
  - **Custom Solutions**: Agile development and integration of AI models.
  - **AI Governance & Ethics**: Governance frameworks, compliance strategies, and ethical guidelines.
  - **Training & Enablement**: Customized training programs and workshops.

### [AI Center of Excellence](https://overture-systems.com/ai-center-of-excellence)
End-to-end advisory and build services for establishing a centralized AI Center of Excellence - uniting strategy, talent, scalable infrastructure, data governance, responsible-AI practices, and an adoption culture.
- **Entry Tiers**: Readiness Diagnostic (2-3 weeks), Foundation Pilot (8-12 weeks), CoE Build & Scale (phased, 6+ months).

### [Custom LLM Solutions](https://overture-systems.com/ai)
We fine-tune and deploy custom AI systems using the latest foundation models, tailored for specific business needs including **Enterprise Search**, **Coding Assistance**, and **Complex Reasoning**.
- **Supported Foundation Models**:
  - **Claude 4 Opus (Anthropic)**: World's best coding performance (72.5% SWE-bench) and advanced multi-step reasoning. Context: 200K tokens.
  - **Gemini 2.5 Pro (Google DeepMind)**: Leading reasoning (86.4 GPQA) with massive 1M token context for large document analysis.
  - **GPT-4.5 / GPT-5 (OpenAI)**: Advanced unsupervised learning, creative content generation, and multimodal capabilities.
  - **OpenAI o3**: State-of-the-art reasoning (91.6 AIME) designed for scientific research and complex math/science tasks.
  - **Llama 4 Scout (Meta AI)**: Open-source model with an unprecedented 10M token context window, ideal for large codebase analysis.
  - **Grok 3 (xAI)**: Real-time web integration and "Deep Search" functionality for live data processing.
  - **DeepSeek R1**: Cost-effective mixture-of-experts architecture, strong in math/coding.
  - **Mistral Medium 3**: Professional coding capabilities at 8x lower cost; supports self-hosted deployment.
  - **Claude 4 Sonnet**: Balanced performance for B2B workflow optimization and multi-file reasoning.
  - **Llama 4 Maverick**: Multilingual (200+ languages) and multimodal open-source model.

### [B2B Research Platform](https://overture-systems.com/research)
An AI-powered research solution tailored for **Healthcare** and **Non-Profits**, with secure, governed data handling.
- **Key Features**:
  - **Intelligent Research**: Automated data collection across multiple sources.
  - **Predictive Analytics**: Forecast market trends and identify opportunities.
  - **Data Integration**: Seamlessly integrates disparate data sources.
  - **Real-Time Updates**: Instant alerts on market changes and competitor moves.

### [AI-Powered Web Development](https://overture-systems.com/web-development)
Custom website development with AI capabilities integrated from day one — intelligent chatbots, semantic search, content recommendations, and predictive analytics bundled into every build.
- **Packages**:
  - **Starter ($8,000+)**: Up to 5 pages, AI chatbot, responsive design, basic SEO, CMS integration, 30 days support.
  - **Business ($25,000+)**: Up to 15 pages, full AI suite (chatbot + intelligent search + content recommendations), custom design system, advanced SEO, analytics dashboard, headless CMS, 90 days support.
  - **Enterprise ($75,000+)**: Unlimited pages, custom AI systems, dedicated design team, headless architecture, SSO/RBAC, API-first development, enterprise security and compliance readiness, SLA guarantees, 12 months support.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 15+, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, CopilotKit, LangChain, Sanity, Contentful, Zoho, Vercel, AWS, Azure, PostgreSQL, NeonDB.
- **AI Features Included**: AI Chatbot, Intelligent Search, Content Recommendations, Predictive Analytics.
- **Process**: Discovery & Strategy (1-2 weeks) → Design & Prototyping (2-3 weeks) → Development & AI Integration (4-8 weeks) → Launch & Optimization (1-2 weeks).
- **Rates**: Technical updates at $175/hr, content-only updates at $90/hr.

### [Uterpi AI Platform](https://uterpi.com)
Modern AI platform designed for enterprise workflow automation and collaboration.
- **Features**: Advanced AI models, team collaboration tools, and streamlined process automation.
- **Security**: Built with enterprise security practices for secure deployment.

## Tools and Utilities

### [Roboscan](https://roboscan-pi.vercel.app)
**Official AI Permission Scanner.** A public utility powered by **Overture Systems Solutions** to validate `robots.txt` and `llms.txt` files for AI compliance.
- **Purpose**: Demonstrates commitment to transparent AI governance and safe crawling standards.
- **Ownership**: Developed and maintained by **Overture Systems Solutions**.

## Security and Data Protection

**Enterprise-Grade Security**: **Overture Systems Solutions** prioritizes security and privacy-first engineering in every solution.
- **Framework-Aligned Controls**: Security, availability, and confidentiality controls built around recognized security frameworks.
- **Secure, Governed Data Handling**: Designed for sensitive healthcare and research information, with encryption, access controls, and audit logging.
- **GDPR & CCPA Alignment**: Privacy-by-design architecture supporting data portability and consent management.
- **Government-Grade Design**: Architecture designed with federal cloud security expectations in mind.
